summary.en: Sonoko's uncle named Jirokichi Suzuki wants to capture Kaitou Kid to improve his fame, by Kaitou Kid to see if he can steal the jewel called, "Blue Wonder", in reality Jirokichi wants to use it as bait. He sent a message to Kid saying, "Attention Kaitou Kid. I challenge you: I've put the priceless artifact Blue Wonder atop my museum in the city. Come and take it if you can." Later, Kaitou Kid accepts Jirokichi's challenge and will steal the Blue Wonder.
